NAC's ASTRO FIESTA Nov 2026

20, 21 and 22 November 2026

Fun Learn Explore

Admission is Open for all!

​✨ Touch the Stars, Discover the Universe!

​Step away from the everyday and journey into the infinite expanse of the cosmos. Whether you're a curious beginner, an aspiring astronomer, or a family looking for an unforgettable weekend adventure, NAC's Astro Fiesta is your ultimate passport to the stars.

​Join us for three action-packed days where science meets wonder, creativity meets the cosmos, and the universe comes alive right before your eyes.

​🔭 What Awaits You at the Fiesta?

* Workshops

* Hands-On activities

* Creative activities: art, poetry, story telling

* Observations: solar, lunar, planetary and deep sky

* Interactions and meet-up with Professional and Expert Astronomers and Astrophysicists

​🌌 Come One, Come All!

​The universe belongs to everyone. Bring your friends, your family, and your boundless curiosity.

​Mark your calendars for 13–15 November 2026, let’s look up and explore together!
